title: Law to require reporting on housing voucher homeownership program
summary: This bill would require the Department of Housing Preservation and Development to report annually on New York City households' participation in the Housing Choice Voucher Homeownership Program, including eligibility, participation and successful home purchases broken down by borough, income level, household type and race. The agency would also have to seek similar data from New York State Homes and Community Renewal. The first report would be due within one year of the law taking effect.
